title: Mortal Shell II: Reviews and DLSS 4.5 Support Highlighted in Portugal
description: Recent reports from IGN Portugal and TudoCelular.com discuss reviews and NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 support for Mortal Shell II, which is listed among weekly releases.

sources.title: NVIDIA anuncia dois grandes lançamentos de agosto com suporte ao DLSS 4.5
Lançamentos de jogos da semana (17 a 21 de agosto): PS5, Xbox Series, Nintendo Switch e PC

sections.heading: Game Analysis
paragraphs: IGN Portugal has published an analysis of the game titled 'Mortal Shell 2 - Análise'.

sections.heading: Technical Support
paragraphs: TudoCelular.com reports that NVIDIA has announced two major releases for August that support DLSS 4.5, specifically mentioning 'Mortal Shell 2' in this context.

sections.heading: Platform Availability
paragraphs: Oficina da Net included the title in a list of game releases for the week of August 17 to 21. The report covers availability on PS5, Xbox Series, Nintendo Switch, and PC.

faq.q: What sources are reporting on the game?
faq.a: IGN Portugal, TudoCelular.com, and Oficina da Net have published articles regarding the game.
According to TudoCelular.com, the game is among the releases supporting NVIDIA DLSS 4.5.
